question.prompt: How many subsets does the set \(\{1,2\}\) have in total?

solutions.explanation: A set with \(n\) elements has \(2^n\) subsets. A set with 2 elements has 4 subsets, including the empty set and the set itself.
solutions.title: Subset-count formula

solutions.explanation:
A subset can contain none, one, or both of the two elements. These possibilities give
\[
\varnothing,\qquad \{1\},\qquad \{2\},\qquad \{1,2\}.
\]
Every subset is included because it must have zero, one, or two elements, and the four listed sets are distinct. Therefore there are \(4\) subsets.
solutions.title: List every subset
